_comment: A dead Scrap Hauler, found in Bulky Waste: the hull, the board, the tread rubber. Four
draws, no filler, so a teardown always hands something back.
NO COMPONENT IN THIS POOL, the Broken Terminal's rule: the thing that yields a component is
meant to be the thing that teaches it (ComponentBlueprintTests), and this teaches the two
machine sheets instead - declared at the top level so the fragments are granted without the
pool having to draw the thing they teach. ONE FIND, TWO SHEETS, exactly as broken_terminal.
